title.zh: 一张图看懂 OCD 量测

subtitle.zh: 从光学响应到模型反演与工艺选择
subtitle.en: From optical response to model inversion and method selection

heading.zh: 01 量测定位与 02 光学机理

body.zh: 先测光学响应，再反演结构：晶圆周期测试图形 → 实测光谱（反射率—波长）→ 模型反演截面。结构与材料共同改变光响应；入射光产生镜面反射与可选级次的衍射光。
body.en: Measure optical response first, then infer structure: periodic wafer target → measured reflectance-versus-wavelength spectrum → model-inverted cross-section. Structure and materials jointly alter optical response, including specular reflection and selectable diffraction orders.

heading.zh: 03 目标结构与 04 模型建立

body.zh: 测试图形要匹配模型与光斑。图示匹配光栅的完整光斑，以及边缘混入周边结构的非理想情况。几何与材料假设决定解释方式，模型包含 CD、高度、侧壁角、层堆栈。
body.en: Targets must match model and optical spot. The figure contrasts a matched grating/spot with unwanted neighboring structures entering the spot edge. Geometry/material assumptions define interpretation, including CD, height, sidewall angle, and stack.

heading.zh: 05 参数反演与 06 可信验证

body.zh: 找到匹配不等于找到唯一答案：不同模型 A/B 与参数组合可能产生相似实测光谱。重复性、偏差和不确定度要分开看；图示一种重复好但偏离参考，另一种重复好且接近参考，坐标为参考值和量测结果。
body.en: A match is not necessarily unique: different models A/B and parameter combinations may yield similar spectra. Separate repeatability, bias, uncertainty; plots compare repeatable-but-biased results with repeatable results near the reference, using reference and measured axes.

heading.zh: 07 异常诊断与 08 方法选择

body.zh: 异常要区分定位/设备问题、模型问题、真实工艺变化。按控制问题组合 OCD（光学量测）、CD-SEM（电子显微镜）、AFM/截面方法（形貌量测）。
body.en: Distinguish positioning/equipment issues, model issues, and true process changes. Combine OCD (optical), CD-SEM (electron microscopy), and AFM/cross-section morphology methods according to the control problem.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。
